description: Get an MCP server's TrustedMCP grade (A-D) by name, npm or PyPI package, Docker image, server URL, GitHub repo or launch command (e.g. 'npx -y @playwright/mcp'). Returns the four checks (login, upkeep, known bugs, connection), what to fix first and the TrustedMCP page. For servers without a grade, returns matching official MCP Registry entries.

query.description: Name, package, image, URL, repo or command, e.g. 'notion', '@playwright/mcp', 'https://mcp.stripe.com'

name: lookup_server
title: Look up an MCP server
